description: Independently verify a chain of receipts against the APEX PSI ledger. Recomputes each hash's presence and integrity and reports Merkle chain continuity. Returns a verification report — a recomputation result, not an opinion or a certification. Read-only: it only looks receipts up and recomputes the chain; nothing is written. Output: a JSON report per receipt (found, verified) and an overall chain-intact verdict. A failure returns a tool error whose text is JSON: { success: false, error }.

receipts.description: Array of receipt objects to verify (in order)

items.description: An APEX PSI receipt object (as returned by the seal tool)

name: verify_chain
title: Verify a receipt chain
